svg.title: Featured Builds — DeepSea, GreenStep India, IBM Z Fraud Detection
svg.desc: Three project cards. DeepSea, an AI-driven ocean monitoring and inspection platform. GreenStep India, an AI-powered sustainability platform. IBM Z Fraud Detection, a machine-learning fraud detection system. Each card lists the project name, a short description, a category label and the GitHub repository.
